theme_and_archetype.mood: Premium, fashion-forward, editorial, sophisticated, like a high-end digital magazine. Emphasizes negative space, sharp contrasts, and high-quality photography.

rules: No generic sans-serif for headings (Inter/Roboto are banned).
Overlines must be uppercase with wide tracking (1.5px).
Tap targets must be a minimum of 48x48px.
Use edge-to-edge imagery for hero sections and lookbook covers.
Generous spacing: use 32px or 48px between major sections instead of standard 16px.

cards.style: Flat, brutalist editorial style. No heavy drop shadows.

icons.style: Duotone or Thin weight to match luxury aesthetic

onboarding_hero.description: Chic fashion portrait of a model in a luxurious white fur coat.
onboarding_hero.usage: Onboarding splash screen or AI Stylist welcome background.

closet_backgrounds.description: Walk-in closet filled with luxury clothes.
closet_backgrounds.usage: Guided capture intro or empty state background for Closet tab.

closet_backgrounds.description: Walk-in closet with mirror and stool.

outfits_lookbooks.description: Flat lay of shoes, hat, and sweater.

testing.requirement: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'testID' (React Native equivalent to 'data-testid') attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build standard React Native/Expo screens using the provided dark luxury theme.
Prioritize smooth gestural animations (e.g., React Native Reanimated) for the guided capture walkthrough.
Use Playfair Display for primary headers and Outfit for body text (configure expo-font).
For the camera/video walkthrough, utilize expo-camera with an overlay frame to act as the 'AI guide'.
Images for dummy data MUST be sourced from the 'media' object in this JSON; do not use placeholders like via.placeholder.com.
Ensure the bottom tab bar uses a blurred, glass-like background to maintain the premium magazine aesthetic.
